args.command: echo '=== input devices ==='; ls -l /dev/input 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== by-id ==='; ls -l /dev/input/by-id 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== libinput pkg ==='; dpkg -l | grep -E 'xserver-xorg-input-libinput|libinput' || true; echo '=== xinput ==='; DISPLAY=:0 xinput list 2>&1 || true; echo '=== xorg input log ==='; grep -Ei 'input|mouse|pointer|libinput|evdev' /var/log/Xorg.0.log 2>/dev/null | tail -n 120 || true

meta.summary: Inspect Mini mouse and Xorg input stack
